body:
From your note "but fix the bridge": the chicken ramp is longer and gentler, hooks on the door sill and lands flat on the ground, with cleats. Also: door with a frame and handle, a real ridge on the roof, tidier nesting boxes.
Picked in Model Compare.
short: Picked: Chicken coop: the bridge fixed

title: Chicken coop: the bridge fixed
